sentences.en: Kyoto gets lots of visitors from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 京都吸引了来自世界各地很多游客。

sentences.en: The extra room proved very useful when we had visitors.
sentences.zh: 多出一个房间在有客人的时候非常有用。

sentences.en: Visitors to that town increase in number year by year.
sentences.zh: 那镇上的游客一年比一年多起来。

senses.zh: 游客, 访问者, 来访者, 参观者
